name: architecture
description: Design the smallest repository-compatible solution and review it against approved requirements.

# Architecture Skill

Inspect approved requirements and relevant repository only. Prefer existing technologies and minimal dependencies. Map every FR/NFR to a component/behavior. Explain component responsibilities, inputs/outputs, main flow, relevant NOT_FOUND/error paths and relevant security. Include one small Mermaid diagram.

`architecture.md`:
# Architecture
## Inputs and Constraints
## Proposed Approach
## Components and Responsibilities
## Data Flow
## Requirement Traceability
## Error Handling and Relevant Security
## Dependencies and Trade-offs
## Diagram

`design-review.md`:
# Design Review
## Scope
## Coverage and Compatibility
## Findings
Severity HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW, evidence, action.
## Decisions and Follow-ups
## Status
No unresolved HIGH findings / Blocked.

One correction cycle for HIGH, then seek human guidance.
